card.name: Inside all-caps words, split pieces
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of split words, mostly in ALL-CAPS warning text (EM in EMERGENCY, DU in REPRODUCE, COR in RECORLEV). Also a stray M piece joining two words run together.

modes.label: EM in emergency
modes.description: The piece EM that starts EMERGENCY(IES) in capitalized warnings.

card.writes: It favors a next piece starting with C, such as CAC or CBC, and disfavors pieces starting with D or M.
card.plain: It fires partway through long capitalized words, especially EMERGENCY in warning text.
